verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published TOPS figure or NPU specification for the 9950X3D (a desktop CPU without an integrated neural engine per the docs), and while the GAIA software (docs-15 to docs-24) shows an SDK/agent framework, it never ties to a hardware NPU or states any TOPS/precision figure for this chip. Missing for 10: NPU/neural-engine hardware presence, published TOPS number, stated precision (e.g., INT8), and confirmation the SDK targets this chip's on-die accelerator rather than GPU/CPU inference.
